rule: Focus on specific design elements like grille patterns and body styles when identifying vehicle models.
failure_pattern: The model was incorrectly predicted as Acura Integra Type R 2001 due to overlooking the specific grille design and body style that are characteristic of the Audi 100 Sedan 1994.

rule: Focus on additional discriminative features such as body style, wheel design, and overall proportions when distinguishing between closely related models.
failure_pattern: The model was unable to distinguish between the BMW ActiveHybrid 5 Sedan 2012 and the BMW 3 Series Sedan 2012 due to their similar visual characteristics.

rule: Verify multiple discriminative features before relying solely on the highest similarity score.
failure_pattern: The model was incorrectly identified as a Bentley Continental Supersports Conv. Convertible 2012 due to a similarity score that was slightly higher than the ground truth but not significantly so.
